objective: Improve token efficiency carefully while preserving pipeline correctness.

decisions.outcome: Exact sharing and tabular encoding implemented behind an off-by-default switch. Offline reconstruction passed 71 saved batches. Live scientific decision divergence prevented default rollout.

Default whitespace-only JSON projection preserves source strings, numeric lexemes, duplicate keys, provider metadata, tool pairing and stored transcript. Current request profiling measures its input-size effects. No additional evidence truncation or memory-window reduction shipped.

Existing concise assessment guidance retained. No hard output cap or schema-field removal introduced; live evaluation showed that smaller input can increase output. Such changes were not justified by the evidence.
Explicit exact-accession and positive-decision constraints added. Corrected live replay returned valid structured records. Invalid outputs remain rejected rather than silently repaired or admitted.

Latest full runtime suite: 1252 passed, 8 skipped. Live controller/checkpoint smoke passed. Integration covers actual review admission, ranking, checkpoint/resume and modeling intake with synthetic provider data, both encodings. Current behavior harness: optimized passes both cases and revisions; baseline failure is retained.

limitations: No new production discovery campaign or GPU job was launched.
Real-world enzyme recovery and statistical noninferiority are not established.
Aggressive evidence factoring is experimental and remains disabled.
acceptance: Default changes preserve supplied evidence and pass the exercised pipeline paths. Higher-risk representation changes were evaluated and withheld from default use rather than claiming unverified equivalence.
